name: finance
description: Money — generate scannable SEPA payment QR codes (EPC069-12) to pre-fill a bank transfer (payment-qr), read read-only banking data (balances, transactions, spending) via bank-mcp, and manage shared expenses, groups, friends and balances on Splitwise via splitwise-mcp (the full Splitwise API v3.0). Both servers are self-hosted on the NAS, each on its own dedicated host behind Cloudflare Access; bank is backed by Enable Banking (Revolut) read-only account information, and each server holds its own provider key server-side. Supply the per-server Cloudflare Access service-token credentials to enable.
